title: Bursar / Accountant
format: Actual application screen captures with fictional isolated demo records; no live authentication, native installation or reconnect sync verification
voice: User-selected English voice-02; not a verified Nigerian-English accent

scenes.label: School link & sign-in
scenes.narration: Open your school's branded link. Staff and parents use their registered phone and four-digit PIN. This recording uses fictional demo records and a local session, not live authentication.

scenes.label: Student balances & debtors
scenes.narration: Choose Fees and Receipts. Review Student Balances and Debtors, then filter owing accounts. Confirm actual bank transfers before issuing official receipts; the figures here are fictional.

scenes.label: Official receipt → A4 preview
scenes.narration: Open Receipts History and inspect the demo receipt. Use the receipt preview to check the details before printing on A four paper. Review the learner, amount and receipt number before printing.

scenes.label: Monthly payroll & payslips
scenes.narration: Open Staff and Payroll. Select the month and review the salary rows. Open the demo payslip to check additions, deductions and net salary before payment.

scenes.label: Teaching & non-teaching staff
scenes.narration: Open Staff and Role Assignments and filter non-teaching staff. Nannies, security, cleaners, drivers and cooks belong on payroll without unnecessary teaching logins.

scenes.label: Install school app
scenes.narration: Open your school's link and choose Install school app. The real help dialog explains Safari and Chrome steps. A native installation is not being verified here.

scenes.label: Online payments & sync limits
scenes.narration: Sign in online and open needed records before offline work. Attendance and score drafts can sync when reconnected; review conflicts. Payments, messages and new sign-ins need internet. This demo does not verify live sync. A locally shown balance is not bank verification.

timingBasis: Detected paragraph-pause cuts, reviewed against expected text length; captions phrase-timed within each recorded scene.
